The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original

delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Note : The selected bidder shall supply RCC Garden Benches made of reinforced cement concrete material. Although the GeM category selected is Garden Bench and the product specification available on GeM may indicate Cast Iron Bench, the bidder is required to supply RCC Cement Concrete Garden Benches as per the required specification and site requirement. The RCC bench shall be of good quality, durable construction, suitable for outdoor installation, and shall be supplied complete in all respects as per the instructions of the consignee. No cast iron bench or a ny other alternative material shall be accepted. Material Requirement : RCC Cement Concrete Garden Bench Material Type : Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) Usage : Outdoor Garden / Public Place Seating Quality : Heavy Duty and Weather Resistant Bidder shall ensure that the supplied product strictly complies with the above additional specificati ons. Any deviation from the specified RCC bench requirement shall lead to rejection of the supplied materi al. Additional Specification Terms 1. The bidder shall complete the mandatory site visit for discussion on product quality within three (3) working days from the date of publication of the bid 2. The site visit shall be carried out during the official working hours of the concerned office. 3. The bidder shall obtain a duly signed and stamped Site Visit Certificate/Confirmation from the a uthorized representative of the purchaser, wherever applicable. 4. Failure to complete the mandatory site visit within the stipulated period of three (3) working da ys from the date of publication of the bid may result in rejection of the bid. .
